doors.why: Big domed hall top-right of Skyreach Plaza with the glowing cyan cross over a wide double door
Top-left building with the red-striped market awning; its blue arched door sits left of the stall

t: THE HOLO-GLOBE. Fourteen worlds turn in its light.
Look closely: one of them is slowly dimming.
A small crystal shrine. Travellers make a wish here before crossing the Wind Bridges.
SKYLINER HALO-1. Boarding by ticket only.
Today's departures: none. Enjoy the view!
GARDEN SHRINE. Leave the flowers, take the quiet.
The Sky Temple lies east, past the last bridge.
THE SKY CRYSTAL. It hums softly.
For a moment you feel someone reading your thoughts.
Pilgrim: I rode the skyliner up from the cloud sea. My ears still haven't popped back.
Dock tech: The airships float on Psi-charged crystals. Don't ask me how. I just polish them.
Skywatcher: Skyreach Plaza is just east. Heal up at the Recovery Bay before the Wind Bridges.
Pilgrim: The holo-globe shows all fourteen worlds at once. I found my home world spinning in it.
Skywatcher: The islands float on updrafts. Don't look down. Seriously, don't.
Mystic: The twins see what you'll do before you do it. They told me you'd come today.
Kid: I caught a Psi-type with a Stasis Pod! Weaken them first or the pod just pops open.
Star scholar: The Sky Temple sits past the Floating Gardens. Echo and Iris guard Halo's Signal Shard.
Plaza guard: Folks in Helix coats kept asking about the temple crystal. Odd questions. I sent them off.
Climber: Trainers on the bridges spot you from five tiles off. Slip past their line of sight if you're tired.
Nurse: Welcome to the Skyreach Recovery Bay. Rest your Alienmon, the thin air tires them out.
Visitor: Psi-types hit hard up here. Bring something sturdy, or bring plenty of healing gel.
Clerk: Welcome to Skyreach Supply! Stock up now, there's no shop past the plaza.
Shopper: I always carry spare Stasis Pods. You never know what drifts out of the clouds.
Bridge walker: The ropes creak, but they've held for three hundred years. Probably.
Pilgrim: Wild Alienmon hide in the pink blossoms. Step around them if your team is worn out.
Skywatcher: See those little islands drifting by? Some of them glitter with Signal Shard dust.
Mystic: The wind sings louder near the temple. The twins say it is singing your name.
Botanist: These blossoms only grow above the clouds. Psi-types nest in them when the wind is calm.
Pilgrim: The Sky Temple is just east. Echo and Iris accept every challenger, but few leave smiling.
Temple pilgrim: The twins wait upstairs. Their apprentices will test you first.
Mystic: One twin starts a sentence, the other finishes it. Don't let it rattle you.

unlisted.114: Domed hall door (4,3), the top shrine (11,2), the airship boarding ramp (17,2-3) and the lower-left dome/shop fronts (4-5,9-11) are drawn but lead nowhere; left blocked. The small shrine island (15-18,12) is reachable over the rope bridge.
unlisted.115: Top-centre dome door (11,2), lower-left dome door (4,11), lower-right dome door (18,11) and the grand stairs running off the bottom edge (11,11-15, final tile 11,15 blocked); rope bridge off the top-left edge (0,3). Left blocked.
unlisted.118: Shrine doors at the top-left (5,1) and top-right (18,2) left blocked; their stairs are walkable.
unlisted.119: Shrine door top-left (4,2); the far tower and rope bridge along the top; the lower-right fountain island (19-23,9-13) is fenced off from the path. Left blocked.
unlisted.120: Treasure chest on the top-left ledge (3,1) left blocked (no chest object kind); stairs off the bottom of the garden island (5-6,13) end at a waterfall, blocked.
unlisted.121: Side stairs (3,5) and (12,5) climb toward the lily-pool terraces and dead-end.

notes: Halo: 118/119/120 left-edge paths are drawn at rows 6-7 with a railing on row 8; row 8 at the edge is opened so the atlas rows 7-8 work. Pink blossom patches on 118-120 are tall grass. 116/117 doormats are the two red-mat tiles [7,13],[8,13]. Keeper Echo & Iris object stands in front of the crystal on 122 (7,4); player challenges from (7,5) or (8,4).
